put.description: Signals Easyrent that a customer(group) with a reservation has arrived in the rental shop.

parameters.name: reservationIdExternal
parameters.description: external ID of reservation or unique RX-Code of a person in a reservation will be allowed

parameters.name: firstName
parameters.description: instead of "reservationIdExternal" firstName+lastName can be provided

parameters.name: lastName
parameters.description: instead of "reservationIdExternal" firstName+lastName can be provided

parameters.name: easygateType
parameters.description: for to put customer into a special Easygate queue (1 = queue for reservations; 2 = queue for check-in; 101 = special queue 1; 102 = special queue 2)

404.description: Reservation with reservationIdExternal not found or "firstName+lastName" is not found or not unique in reservations for today or tomorrow

put.description: creates or updates a so called "basket" in Easyrent for to temporaryly reserve some articles for a dedined limited period. Articles in a basket will not be available any more to other requests

200.description: Basket was successfully created and all articles are available and now reserved

409.description: Content validation error or lack of availablity

cancelVoucherId.description: greater than 0 signals, that a voucher has assign a "cancel voucher" which eliminates this voucher

1 = 14-17 kg 30-38 lbs

4 = 26-30 kg 57-66 lbs
5 = 31-35 kg 67-78 lbs
6 = 36-41 kg 79-91 lbs
7 = 42-48 kg 92-107 lbs
8 = 49-57 kg 108-125 lbs
9 = 58-66 kg 126-147 lbs
10 = 67-78 kg 148-174 lbs
11 = 79-94 kg 175-209 lbs
12 = >= 95 kg >= 210 lbs

deviceTypeId.description: Id of rental articles device type

property2.description: value of property 2 of the rental article. Type of property 2 may be different per device type

property4.description: value of property 4 of the rental article. Type of property 4 may be different per device type

property5.description: value of property 5 of the rental article. Type of property 5 may be different per device type

modelSalesPrice.description: default sales price of rental articles model

locationBranchId.description: ID of Easyrent branch where a rental article is currently located

rentalCount.description: How often a rental article was rented out

rentalDays.description: Total of days a rental article was rented out

profit.description: Total amount earned by renting out the article.

bindingName.description: brand name of rental articles ski binding

bindingBrand.description: brand name of rental articles ski binding

bindingType.description: type of rental articles ski binding. e.g ALPINE, TOUR, OTHER

bindingTorqueRange.description: Torque range of rental articles ski binding. Child, Youth or Adult.

isMultiRent.description: is article of type multiRent (rental article with quantity)

isRentable.description: can article be rented out (status = OK and not isSold)

isRented.description: is rental article currently rented out

returnDate.description: when will article be returned, if it is currently rented out

secondHandPrice.description: Current second-hand price according to Easyrent calculation settings

Easyrent branch to get prices form

number of available articles for the period

reservationextid.description:
unique ID of reservation in reservation system.
If multiple systems are sending reservations, try to keep ID unique by some short prefix

reservationbarcode.description:
reservation system can print a special barcode on the customers voucher to make it possible to lookup reservation in Easyrent system (using RXaannnnnn convention).
Has to be “RX + 6 to 8 alphanumeric characters to be recognized by Easyrent

er_branchid.description:
Easyrent ID of pickup location
Use either "er_branchid" or "branchextid"

branchextid.description:
Pickup location ID in reservation system. Can be mapped to a branch in Easyrent
Use either "er_branchid" or "branchextid"

datecreated.description: date when reservation was created by the customer

datelastupdated.description:
Date and time when reservation was last time altered by the customer in case the reservation system allows changes to already sent reservations.
To update a reservation in Easyrent is has to have a newer "datelastupdated" than the previous version sent.

timefrom.description:
for hourly reservations only
time for beginning of reservation

timeto.description:
for hourly reservations only
time for end of reservation

durationtobill.description: agreed duration to charge a customer for when different from interval of datefrom / dateto (e.g. "city rentals")

pickuptime.description: Date and time when reservation will be picked up (previous day pickup)

cancelled.description: If "true", an existing reservation will be cancelled in Easyrent (if still possible)

amountprepaid.description:
Total amount prepaid for whole reservation.
Either send total amount prepaid in reservation.amountprepaid or send individual amounts with each person. Do not send both!

paymentrefdata.description: payment reference code for an online done full or partial prepayment

voucherlink.description: URL for viewing or reprinting voucher in the reservation system

inloc.description: Input-Location. This information may be used to specify different input locations when reservation is done by travel agencies, tour guides or hotels.

baskets.description: listed baskets will to be deleted when receiving the reservation

reservationbarcode.description: If a reservation system issues a reservationbarcode for each person and prints a reservation ticket for each person this tag can hold the reservationbarcode per person.

countrycode.description: Country code according to ISO-3166 (2 letters) e.g. US, AT, AU

languagecode.description: language code according to  ISO 639-3 (3 letters) e.g. eng, deu, spa, fra

mobile.description: mobile phone number of customer (if not already in telephone and two numbers are needed)

dateofbirth.description: Date of birth is needed for various legal requirements and for beeing able to identify a person.

age.description: Age of person at beginning of reservation (limited use, as Easyrent does not know when age will change)

mainperson.description: If a reservation holds multiple persons one and only one person has to be defined as "mainperson=true" (required when sending multiple persons)

customer weight range (send weight range, kg or lbs - just one)
0 = 10-13 kg 22-29 lbs
1 = 14-17 kg 30-38 lbs
2 = 18-21 kg 39-47 lbs
3 = 22-25 kg 48-56 lbs
4 = 26-30 kg 57-66 lbs
5 = 31-35 kg 67-78 lbs

10 = 67-78 kg 148-174 lbs
11 = 79-94 kg 175-209 lbs
12 = >= 95 kg >= 210 lbs

weightkg.description: customer weight in kg (send weight range, kg or lbs - just one)

weightlbs.description: customer weight in lbs (send weight range, kg or lbs - just one)

heightcm.description: customer height in cm (send height range, cm or inch - just one)

heightinch.description: customer height in inch (send height range, cm or inch - just one)

er_isoskiertypeid.description:
customer skier type classificaton
!!Watch out for 0-based index!!
0 = Type I (1) (beginner)
1 = Type II (2) (advanced)
2 = Type III (3) (expert)
3 = Type I- (1-)
4 = Type III+ (3+)

solemm.description: solelength of an ISO skiing boot

bootrecommendation.description: boot recommendation value of a foot scanner

amountprepaid.description:
Individual amount prepaid of person.
Either send total amount prepaid in reservation.amountprepaid or send individual amounts with each person. Do not send both!

coverage.description: Activate Easyrent internal functionality for coverage on person level

remark.example: would like to get an extreme carver

easygatetype.description:
put customer into easygate queue
1 = queue for reservations
2 = queue for check-in
101 = special queue 1
102 = special queue 2

easygateboot.description: Indicate, if customer in easygate queue needs to rent boots

er_custid.description: Easyrent customer ID if known by reservation system

er_hotelid.description: Easyrent hotel ID if known by reservation system

travelagencycode.description: Easyrent code of a travel agency (if known by reservation system)

voucherlink.description: URL for viewing or reprinting persons voucher in the reservation system

articletype.description:
Type of reserved article. Defaults to "R" (rental) if missing
"R" = Rental
"D" = Depot
"M" = Merchandise (sales article)

er_rentalgroupid.description: Easrent ID of rental group ( or depot group)

er_depotlocationid.description:
Easrent ID of depot location
Needed if articletype = "D" and there are multiple depot locations for one branch

rentalgroupextid.description:
Rental group ID from reservation system (has to be mapped within Easyrent to one or more er_rentalgroupIds)
In case of a sales article it has to be the sales article code.

rentalgroupname.description: Human readable name of reserved product

er_modelid.description: Easrent ID of specific model of a rental categorie

modelname.description: human readable name of a specifi model of a rental categorie

datefrom.description:
Special from/to for this artcile
Has to be within period of overall reservation from/to !!

dateto.description:
Special from/to for this artcile
Has to be within period of overall reservation from/to !!

timefrom.description:
Special from/to for this artcile
Has to be within period of overall reservation from/to !!

timeto.description:
Special from/to for this artcile
Has to be within period of overall reservation from/to !!

quantity.description: Quantity of rented products (typically 1). Default to "1" of missing.

netprice.description:
Price of article after discount reduction (including tax according to tax system used on Easyrent side)
!! Required, if article prices are sent

grossprice.description: Price of article before reduction (including tax according to tax system used on Easyrent side)

addon1name.description: human readable name of add-on product

addon2name.description: human readable name of add-on product

costOfGoodsSold.description: only filled for items of type "goods"

basketid.description: possibly use GUID for to make sure basketid is unique within Easyrent

er_branchid.description: ID of a specific branch (location) within Easyrent

er_rentalgroupid.description: ID of rental group or depot group

er_modelid.description: ID of model of a rental article

er_depotlocatonid.description: ID of depot location; mandatory in case of depot article article

personid.description: identifier for a person in a cart

age.description: age in years of a person, if date of birth is not known

cancellable.description: Indcation if reservation can be cancelled from Easyrent technical point of view

updatable.description: Indcation if reservation can still be updated from Easyrent technical point of view

printed.description: in most systems indcation that reservation items have already been prepared for a person
